demo_mailbox: This demo mailbox holds {count, plural, one {{count, number} message} other {{count, number} messages}}.
signin_error_credentials: Couldn’t sign in. Check the name and password, then try again.
signin_error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. You can try again in a few minutes. If you’re locked out, your admin can reset your password.
signin_error_unavailable: Couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
signin_admin_note: Accounts are created by your admin.
legal_no_warranty: This program comes with absolutely no warranty.
legal_may_convey: Licensees may convey it under the GNU AGPL, version 3.
sessions_revoke_others_note: Signs out every session except this one.
sessions_revoked_others_toast: {count, plural, one {{count, number} other session revoked.} other {{count, number} other sessions revoked.}}
sessions_revoke_failed: Couldn’t revoke that session. Try again.
signout_failed: Couldn’t sign out on the server. This session ends when it expires.
password_error_current: Couldn’t save. Check your current password, then try again.
password_changed_toast: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
choose_password_reason: An admin reset your password, so the one-time password only gets you this far.
session_ended: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
users_create_explanation: The new user gets a one-time password, shown once the account exists. At first sign-in they pick their own.
users_create_failed: Couldn’t create the user. Try again.
users_error_login_taken: That sign-in name is already in use.
users_error_login_shape: Use a shorter sign-in name without spaces.
users_reset_explanation: {name} gets a one-time password to sign in with and picks a new one right away. Every session of {name} is signed out.
users_reset_failed: Couldn’t reset the password. Try again.
users_issued_note: Shown once. It works for one sign-in until {deadline}, then {name} sets a password of their own.
users_issued_note_reset: Shown once. It works for one sign-in until {deadline}, then {name} sets a password of their own. Every session of {name} is now signed out.
users_copy_failed: Couldn’t copy. Select it and copy by hand.
account_lead: Your mail stays at your provider. This is where you read it.
account_detecting: Checking {address}, looking up the mail server for this address…
account_no_providers: Google and Microsoft sign-in are not set up here.
account_hint_gmail: Gmail sign-in needs an app password instead of your Google password. Create one under Google Account → Security → 2-Step Verification → App passwords.
account_hint_icloud: iCloud sign-in needs an app-specific password instead of your Apple Account password. Create one at account.apple.com under Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords.
account_hint_yahoo: Yahoo sign-in needs an app password instead of your Yahoo password. Create one under Yahoo Account Security → Generate app password.
account_hint_fastmail: Fastmail sign-in needs an API token instead of your password. Create one under Fastmail Settings → Privacy & security → API tokens.
account_hint_microsoft: Microsoft accounts sign in through Microsoft itself, never with a password. That needs a Microsoft sign-in set up here, which the admin does by registering an app in Microsoft Entra and entering its client id and secret.
account_confirm_password: Connect to this server? Your password is only sent after you confirm.
account_confirm_token: Connect to this server? Your token is only sent after you confirm.
account_not_found: Couldn’t find the mail server for this address. You can try again or enter the server details yourself.
account_insecure: This server only offers an unencrypted connection. Anything sent to it, including your password, could be read along the way, so the connection is refused.
account_insecure_advice: Ask whoever runs this mail server to enable encryption (most servers have it switched off rather than missing).
account_error_address: Enter a mail address like you@example.com.
account_error_server: Enter a server name like mail.example.com or a JMAP address starting with https://.
account_error_credentials_password: Couldn’t sign in. Check the address and the password, then try again.
account_error_credentials_token: Couldn’t sign in. Check the address and the token, then try again.
account_error_unreachable: Couldn’t reach {host}. Check the server name, then try again.
account_error_unsupported: {host} doesn’t answer like a mail server. Check the server name, then try again.
account_error_server_again: The server for {name} didn’t answer as expected. Try again in a moment.
account_error_smtp_auth: This mailbox doesn’t allow sending from other apps. Ask whoever runs it to turn on SMTP AUTH.
account_error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. You can try again in a few minutes.
account_error_invalid: Couldn’t connect with these details. Check them, then try again.
account_error_gone: This account was removed meanwhile. You can add it again from the start.
account_offline: You’re offline, so nothing can be checked right now. This picks up again the moment you’re back online.
